presentation.keinePraesentation: This document is not a presentation
presentation.ueberlauf: Content runs past the edge of the slide
presentation.hinweis.themeUnbekannt: Unknown theme “{wert}”; the theme “light” is shown.
presentation.hinweis.themeUngueltig: The “theme” entry in the header is invalid; the theme “light” is shown.
presentation.hinweis.slotUnbekannt: Unknown design value “{wert}” under “theme” is ignored.
presentation.hinweis.slotWertUngueltig: Invalid value for “{wert}” under “theme”; the theme’s value applies.
presentation.hinweis.folieWertUngueltig: Invalid value for “{wert}” in a setting on this slide; the previous value applies.
presentation.hinweis.folieThemeUnbekannt: Unknown theme “{wert}” in a setting on this slide; the previous theme applies.
presentation.hinweis.headingDividerUngue: Invalid value for “headingDivider”; the setting is ignored.
presentation.export.pdfFehler: PDF export of the slides failed: {error}
presentation.export.htmlFehler: HTML export of the slides failed: {error}
presentation.export.pptxFehler: PowerPoint export of the slides failed: {error}
presentation.export.pptxFehlerFolie: PowerPoint export of the slides failed at slide {folie}: {error}
presentation.export.pptxGrund.zeitbudget: the slide was not drawn in time
presentation.export.pptxGrund.laden: the slide could not be loaded
presentation.export.pptxGrund.aufnahme: the image of the slide could not be captured
presentation.export.pptxGrund.masse: the image of the slide does not have the expected size
presentation.export.pptxGrund.prozess: the rendering of the slide stopped unexpectedly
presentation.export.pptxGrund.eingabe: the slides could not be handed over
presentation.export.pptxGrund.groesse: the slides are too large for a PowerPoint file
presentation.export.pptxGrund.schreiben: the file could not be written
presentation.export.bilderDialogTitel: Choose a folder for the slide images
presentation.export.bilderFehler: Image export of the slides failed: {error}
presentation.export.bilderFehlerFolie: Image export of the slides failed at slide {folie}: {error}
presentation.export.ordnerDialogTitel: Choose a folder for the slide pages
presentation.vorlage.punkt1: A line with three hyphens starts a new slide.
presentation.vorlage.punkt2: The header sets the look: theme is light, dark or accent.
presentation.vorlage.punkt3: paginate: true in the header shows the page number on every slide.
presentation.vorlage.notiz: Speaker note: it is not shown on the slide and not included in the exports.
presentation.vorlage.zweiteilungTitel: Image and text side by side
presentation.vorlage.zweiteilungText: An image written as {bg} fills the background of the slide. Written as {links}, it sits on the left and the text moves to the right.
presentation.slot.heading: Headings
presentation.gestaltung.hinweis: These settings apply to this file only and are stored in its header. Each value follows the chosen theme until you set your own.
presentation.gestaltung.werteUebernehmen: Copy theme values into the file
presentation.gestaltung.alsThemeHinweis: The design becomes a custom theme; the file then refers only to its name.
presentation.gestaltung.nurAenderbar: The design can only be set in an editable presentation
presentation.gestaltung.kopfDefekt: The file header is invalid; the design was not written
presentation.gestaltung.verworfen: The document has changed in the meantime; the design was not written
presentation.themes.hinweis: Custom themes for presentations. A theme builds on a built-in one and applies to every file that names it in its header.
presentation.themes.name: Name
presentation.themes.vorschauText: This is how the text of a slide looks.
presentation.themes.vorschauVerweis: A link in the accent colour
presentation.themes.nameLeer: The name must not be empty.
presentation.themes.nameMitgeliefert: This name belongs to a built-in theme.
presentation.themes.nameVergeben: A theme with this name already exists.
